== Summary ==
Players Committee errata slip for Lone Rogue, cut unchanged at 300 dpi from page 26 of the PC's ''Decipher Errata'' sheet “Official text as of January 1, 2013” (PDF made 16 April 2013): [http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf DecipherErrata.pdf]. Preserved copy of the sheet: [https://web.archive.org/web/20160809094140/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/DecipherErrata.pdf Internet Archive]. SHA-1 of this file: f461d80b912dd3ff5e74d77e1ee5c1b27aa011d4. Shown on [[Lone Rogue (PC Errata 2013 slip)]].
